versions.content: Restriction to declaration of vendor id entification The vendor identification shall be declared only in the following way, without any cast, to allow verification in a pre - processor. #define <MIP>_VENDOR_ID <vi> Where <vi> is the corresponding Vendor Id, as required in [ SW S_BSW_00059 ].
